name: Perales del Puerto (Spain)
description: Green field with a white Scandinavian cross set towards the fly, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Perales del Puerto (a pear tree and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Perales del Puerto; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Scandinavian cross with the crossing in the fly half
Perales del Puerto arms — pear tree and lion
